import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# 1) all-ones frame grouped: gb.kurt(skipna=False)
try:
    df = pd.DataFrame(np.ones((4, 2)), columns=['a', 'b'])
    gb = df.groupby([0, 0, 1, 1])
    res = gb.kurt(skipna=False)
    probe("all-ones frame grouped: gb.kurt(skipna=False)  # test_groupby_kurt_all_ones", res)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("all-ones frame grouped: gb.kurt(skipna=False)  # test_groupby_kurt_all_ones", e)

# 2) GH 62946 low-variance windows: Rolling.skew/kurt on normal(loc=0.0, scale=1e-18, size=(20,))
try:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    s = pd.Series(rng.normal(loc=0.0, scale=1e-18, size=(20,)))
    skew = s.rolling(window=5).skew()
    kurt = s.rolling(window=5).kurt()
    probe("GH 62946 low-variance windows: Rolling.skew/kurt on normal(loc=0.0, scale=1e-18, size=(20,))", (skew, kurt))
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("GH 62946 low-variance windows: Rolling.skew/kurt on normal(loc=0.0, scale=1e-18, size=(20,))", e)

# 3) GH 62864 degenerate distribution s and DataFrame df (all values identical)

    s = pd.Series([5] * 10)
    df = pd.DataFrame({'a': [5] * 10, 'b': [5] * 10})
    probe("GH 62864 degenerate distribution s and DataFrame df (all values identical)", (s.skew(), s.kurt(), df.skew(), df.kurt()))
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("GH 62864 degenerate distribution s and DataFrame df (all values identical)", e)
